method.intelligence: Chance-corrected accuracy, 80% public / 20% sealed, with the v1.4 penalty when the public-to-sealed accuracy gap exceeds 25 points. Invalid or missing answers count as incorrect.
method.calibration: 10-bin top-label ECE scaled by valid probability coverage; label-only outputs receive zero calibration.
method.speed: p50 and p95 whole-call latency; local latency uses the v1.4 2× plus 0.15-second adjustment.
method.cost: Hosted cost uses returned OpenRouter usage receipts; missing receipts are not zero-filled, and the cost axis is scaled by receipt coverage. Local cost uses measured GPU seconds at USD 1.19/GPU-hour. Retry calls are tracked separately.
method.composite: Equal-weight harmonic mean of Intelligence, Calibration, Speed, and Cost, followed by the v1.4 intelligence, speed, and cost gates below 50.
method.difficulty: Real-source difficulty labels are not comparable. The core split is balanced by source and within-source normalized task-length tertiles as a disclosed proxy.

exposure.hosted: All four hosted systems received sealed images and questions through the requested no-retention route with provider fallback disabled; they carry the API flag.
exposure.label_checkers: GPT-6 Luna and Gemini 3.8 Flash saw 100 public promo-photo candidates and 68 new sealed-photo candidates in stateless single-turn label checks, including candidates later dropped. No gold labels were shown; human gold-blind review decided inclusion.
exposure.djev_spark: djev-spark saw the 100 public promo photos in the earlier inference-only video run, with no training. Its score on the 61 new sealed photo variants is the independent measure.
